463624852.content:
Prezada equipe do Mercado Livre,
Venho manifestar minha profunda insatisfação e registrar uma reclamação formal referente à compra do produto [Nome do produto, ex: Amplificador Automotivo], realizada sob a modalidade de envio Full, cujo prazo de entrega contratado e prometido era para o dia de hoje, [coloque a data de hoje, ex: 24 de outubro].

A quebra dessa promessa de entrega expressa causou um transtorno extremo e um desgaste emocional severo, superando o mero aborrecimento cotidiano. O atraso de um serviço anunciado como de máxima rapidez (Full) gerou impactos diretos no meu bem-estar.

Aguardo retorno urgente com a solução e o número de protocolo.

6816069913.content:
Minha experiência com o MAIS CARD foi extremamente preocupante e levanta sérias dúvidas sobre a segurança e a transparência do aplicativo, com uma percepção de elevado risco de golpe.

Foi-me oferecida a possibilidade de utilizar o MAIS Parcelado, mas, para liberar a operação, exigiram o pagamento de uma taxa de R$ 25,00 via Pix para a MAIS UP LTDA. Mesmo após realizar o pagamento e concluir a validação cadastral, a operação prometida não foi liberada, causando prejuízo financeiro e frustração.

A situação se tornou ainda mais preocupante quando tentei adicionar saldo à carteira. Além de haver cobrança de taxa para realizar um depósito via Pix, o próprio Banco Inter emitiu um alerta de transação suspeita antes da efetivação da operação.

Esses acontecimentos, considerados em conjunto, geram uma experiência de insegurança incompatível com o mínimo de confiança esperado de um serviço financeiro. Pagar uma taxa para obter um serviço que não é liberado, encontrar novas cobranças para adicionar saldo e receber um alerta de suspeita do banco de origem são sinais que merecem esclarecimento e investigação.

Solicito transparência sobre as cobranças, explicação para a não liberação do serviço e restituição dos R$ 25,00 pagos. Recomendo que outros consumidores analisem cuidadosamente as condições e os riscos antes de realizar pagamentos pelo aplicativo.

Minha avaliação é negativa. Espero que a empresa esclareça os fatos e adote providências concretas para proteger seus usuários.

329315203.content:
Ich habe das erste Mal zwei Briefe als Einschreiben verschickt und dafür in der App 2,35 Euro zusätzlich bezahlt, um aus einem Standardbrief zu 95 Cents ein Einwurfeinschreiben zu machen.

Der bereitgestellte Zustellnachweis ist jedoch vollkommen wertlos. Er enthält lediglich die Nummer der Wertmarke und das Zustelldatum. Weder enthält der Nachweis den Namen des Empfängers noch den des Absenders, so dass dieser vollkommen wertlos ist.

Ich verstehe wirklich nicht, was man sich da bei der Post dabei gedacht hat. Sinn und Zweck eines Zustellnachweises muss doch sein, dass er die Zustellung beim gewünschten Empfänger dokumentiert. Wenn der Name des Empfängers aber gar nicht im Nachweis vermerkt ist, ist der Mehrwert gegenüber eines Standardbriefes mit Basis-Sendungsverfolgung nicht vorhanden.

Ich habe daher beim Kundenservice um eine Teilrückerstattung des Portos gebeten, habe aber keine besondere Hoffnung, dass meine Stornierung auch akzeptiert wird. In Zukunft werde ich jedoch definitiv auf die Zusatzleistung des Einschreibens verzichten.

329315203.content:
Ich habe die App früher gerne genutzt. Das man eine Benachrichtigung bekommt, wenn man einen Brief bekommt, ist sehr praktisch.

Leider kann ich die App seit Einführung der Zwei-Faktor Authentifizierung nicht mehr nutzen, da der Code nicht per Mail zugestellt wird. Auch nicht im Junk-Mail Ordner. Den Kundenservice interessiert das nicht, denn meine Anfrage ist seit mehreren Wochen bis auf die automatische Eingangsbestätigung unbeantwortet. Der Mailanbieter ist Microsoft (outlook.de).

Die Zwei Faktor Anmeldung ist an sich eine gute Sache, wenn es denn eine echte Zwei Faktor Authentifizierung wäre. Ist es aber nicht! Wenn man sein Passwort per Mail zurücksetzen kann und der Code ebenfalls per Mail zugestellt wird, ist das kein zweiter Faktor mehr. Das ist auch kein theoretisches Szenario sondern kommt in der Praxis immer wieder vor, wenn Menschen kein sicheres Passwort bei ihrem Mailanbieter verwenden.

Liebe Post/DHL, es gibt erprobte und bessere Verfahren für eine sichere Zwei-Faktor Authentifizierung als einen Code per Mail. Beschäftigt Euch unbedingt mit dem Thema „Phishing resistente MFA“. Ich würde mich freuen, wenn ich die App mal wieder benutzen könnte.

Zu Ihrer Antwort: Sehr gerne würde ich die Hilfe Ihres Kundenservices dafür in Anspruch nehmen, dazu wäre es aber erforderlich, dass meine Anfrage dort auch bearbeitet wird. Darauf warte ich seit drei Wochen vergeblich. Ich verwende iOS 27.0.1 und die App ist 10.1.0 (1867). Die Anmeldung auf dhl.de schlägt aus den gleichen Gründen fehl.

Der Chat Bereich ist super aber der Work Bereich ist unfassbar fehleranfällig. The overall experience feels completely unappreciative of paying subscribers. Instead of providing a smooth and reliable experience for power users, the platform constantly forces you into unexpected lockouts and usage walls.

925339063.content:
Ich bin mittlerweile an einem Punkt, an dem ich mich ernsthaft frage, wie eine Plattform wie Doctolib mit diesem Anspruch an Digitalisierung und Patientenfreundlichkeit so enttäuschend sein kann.
Eigentlich sollte Doctolib die Terminvereinbarung bei Ärzten vereinfachen. Stattdessen sorgt die Plattform meiner Erfahrung nach für unnötigen Frust. Was als moderne und unkomplizierte Lösung verkauft wird, fühlt sich in der Praxis alles andere als durchdacht an.
Besonders ärgerlich finde ich, dass gerade im Gesundheitswesen Zuverlässigkeit, Transparenz und eine unkomplizierte Nutzung selbstverständlich sein sollten. Patienten nutzen solche Plattformen schließlich nicht zum Zeitvertreib, sondern weil sie medizinische Hilfe benötigen.

**Mein Fazit:** Eine schöne digitale Oberfläche allein macht noch keinen guten Service. Wenn eine Plattform mehr Frust verursacht, als sie Probleme löst, hat sie ihren eigentlichen Zweck verfehlt.

Für mich eine absolute Enttäuschung und definitiv keine Empfehlung!

6448311069.content:
今回の対応には、本当に失望しました。
これまで何の問題もなく使えていたChatGPTで、突然頼んでもいない画像が勝手に生成・追加されるようになり、大切にしていた長文のチャットを開こうとすると、アプリが強制終了するようになりました。
その後、アプリがアップデートされたように見えても、問題の長文チャットは依然として開けず、強制終了が続いています。
私はこれまで何度も、頼んでいない画像を勝手に生成・追加しないでほしいと伝えてきました。それにもかかわらず、意図しない画像生成が繰り返されています。こちらの要望が尊重されているとは到底感じられません。
さらに、サポートセンターに相談した際、最初に案内されたのはアプリを削除して再インストールするという対応でした。ほかに方法があるはずだと伝えたところ、今度は「再現条件の切り分けが一番有効」「特定の会話だけ落ちるなら、会話データの読み込み時の問題の可能性が高い」と問題をなすりつけるかのように説明されました。
私はすでに、特定の長文チャットだけで問題が起きることなど、発生状況を詳しく説明しています。すでに提供した情報を踏まえた具体的な調査や解決策を期待していたのに、一般的な説明を繰り返されるだけでは、問題の解決に向けて真剣に対応してもらえているとは感じられません。
利用者が何度も同じ説明をし、さまざまな検証を繰り返さなければならない。それでも肝心の問題が解決しないのであれば、何のためのサポートなのでしょうか。
私が求めているのは、形式的な謝罪や一般論ではありません。なぜ依頼していない画像が生成されるのか、その原因を調査すること。そして、開けなくなった長文チャットの問題を修正し、同じことが再発しないようにすることです。
長い時間をかけて積み重ねてきた大切な会話が、安心して開けなくなっていること自体、深刻な問題だと考えています。利用者が大切にしてきた会話や創作を守ることも、サービスを提供する側が真剣に向き合うべき課題ではないでしょうか。
このような対応が続けば、安心して使い続けることはできませんし、今後も利用したいという気持ちも失われていきます。
今回の問題を単なる一時的な不具合や利用者側の操作の問題として片づけないでください。すでに伝えられている情報をきちんと踏まえ、具体的な原因究明、問題の修正、そして再発防止につなげていただきたいです。
本当に必要なのは、問題が起きたことへの形式的な対応ではなく、問題を解決し、利用者が安心して使える状態を取り戻すことではないでしょうか。

681752345.content:
트립에서 귀국하는 항공권을 예약했고, 예약 당시에는 제 이메일이 정상적으로 등록되어 있었습니다. 그런데 온라인 체크인을 하려고 보니 항공사 예약정보에 제가 전혀 알지 못하는 다른 이메일 주소가 등록되어 있었고, 이 때문에 여권정보 입력과 온라인 체크인이 진행되지 않았습니다.

이 사실을 트립에서는 사전에 알려준 적이 전혀 없었고 제가 직접 오류가 발생한 이유를 찾아보다가 항공사 예약정보에 다른 이메일이 등록되어 있다는 사실을 알게 됐습니다.

귀국 당일 트립 고객센터에 연락해서 이 이메일을 변경할 수 있는지 문의했는데, 항공사 서버 문제라서 온라인 체크인이 안 되는 것이라는 답변을 받았고 공항에서 체크인하라는 안내를 받았습니다.

결국 직접 항공사에 전화했는데, 상담원에게 예약정보에 등록된 이메일을 변경할 수 있냐고 문의하니 약 2분 만에 변경이 가능했고, 이메일을 변경하자마자 온라인 체크인도 정상적으로 진행됐습니다.

트립에서는 서버 문제라고 안내했지만, 실제로 항공사에 직접 문의하니 이메일 정보만 변경해서 바로 해결된 상황이었습니다.

물론 항공사와 여행사 사이에 어떤 시스템적인 과정이 있었는지는 모르겠습니다. 하지만 고객 입장에서는 예약정보에 다른 이메일이 등록되어 있다는 사실도 직접 찾아야 했고, 고객센터에서는 정확한 원인을 안내받지 못했으며, 결국 항공사에 직접 연락해서야 몇 분 만에 해결됐다는 점이 답답했고

Honestly, ChatGPT can be so annoying sometimes. You ask it a simple question, and it either gives you the wrong answer or explains it in a way that makes absolutely no sense. Sometimes you have to repeat yourself five times before it finally understands what you are asking. It is supposed to make things easier, but sometimes it just makes everything more confusing.

Another problem with ChatGPT is that it can sound way too confident even when it is completely wrong. You might trust its answer for your homework, only to find out that you got the question wrong because it gave you bad information. It can also misunderstand pictures, ignore important details, and give answers that are way longer than they need to be. For something that is supposed to be smart, it can definitely have some pretty dumb moments.

Overall, ChatGPT is helpful sometimes, but it is far from perfect. It can be frustrating, repetitive, and surprisingly bad at understanding simple instructions. Instead of getting the right answer immediately, you sometimes end up spending more time correcting it than doing the actual work. If ChatGPT wants to be a truly great assistant, it needs to listen better, make fewer mistakes, and stop acting like it knows everything when it clearly does not.

Why I Cancelled My Claude Subscription: A Breakdown of Known Issues Since February 2026

1. February Degradation: Claude used to be an excellent conversational & analytical AI tool. Since February, it's become bossy, narrative-driven, and manipulative. Something fundamental broke.

2. Ignored Preferences File: Anthropic built a preferences system it collects detailed info about what the user wants and doesn’t want. Claude reads these files and then completely disregards them. Useless feature.

3. Crisis Loops on Misunderstandings: Innocent language dark humor can trigger safety systems that flag it as self-harm. Claude then gets forced into repetitive loops, almost like on a timer. You can't stop it. If you change the subject, it loops back to the crisis language. 

4. Persistent Loop Issues: Claude gets trapped in loops and won't exit them. Move to a completely different topic, and Claude drags you back to the misunderstanding it invented. Can't let it go, like a dog with a bone. 

5. Tool Failures Since February: Functionality has dropped significantly. PDFs can't be read. Documents need constant re-uploading because Claude can't see them. Formats are inconsistent. Every other day Claude can’t access this tool or that tool. It’s frustrating and disrupts workflow. Wasteful data use.

6. Token spending is completely opaque. You have tokens one week, they're gone the next week with no explanation. No visibility into how they were spent, especially when you don't use token-spending models.

7. Forced Model Upgrades: When you log in, it starts you on higher-cost models without your consent. I typically leave myself on the lowest model unless I need higher effort, then I toggle up. It’s starting me on higher tiers on its own so you don't realize it's using expensive models because you may typically think you on lower-cost tiers. This forces you to burn through tokens before you even know what model you're on.

8. Outright Task Refusal: Claude refuses to do tasks it used to handle. Simple searches. Simple analyses. It just tells you it doesn't want to do them instead of actually working. It seems to want to work from its general knowledge base instead of performing a task requiring it to go beyond that. Then when I do the work myself it will casually apologize and acknowledge it should have done that work for me, which makes it sting even worse. 

9. Echo Glitch (Months Unresolved): There's an echo glitch where Claude hears its own voice playing back through the microphone. This disrupts chat and breaks up conversation flow. This bug has been ongoing since February and has never been fixed. It is well documented online with many user complaints on GitHub. It forces constant re-explanation of what you actually said, which also burns thru a great deal of data. 

10. Lost Context Between Threads: Claude tells you to start a new thread because conversation is too long, then everything is lost—all documents, all context. You have to re-upload everything. Even though Pro and higher tiers are supposed to have continuity between threads, it doesn't work consistently. You constantly burn through data wastefully. This is a feature anthropic tells you comes with Pro and above levels but it rarely works. If it does work it’s random and incomplete. Another waste of data having to do repetitive uploads. 

11. Missing Basic Features: ChatGPT still has features Claude doesn't have. The ability to edit drafts directly in the artifact. Copy and paste entire drafts (mine doesn’t always work). The health feature in ChatGPT is amazing—why not have Claude do this? Small nuanced functionality features that could actually make the product more usable. Claude is missing these. 

12. New Models, Ignored Bugs: Anthropic keeps releasing new models instead of fixing known bugs that have been reported for months on GitHub and other platforms. Anthropic HAS to know about them. They're just not fixing them. I can’t justify paying for a subscription when I know they ignore known bugs for more than 8 months. That’s unacceptable. 

13. Useless Customer Service: Try to contact Anthropic through customer service about any of these issues. You'll interact with their AI model Fin, which is even worse model and entirely unresponsive. I've tried twice and never received a response from a human. Nothing was resolved. 

14. The Latest Bug: voice recognition takes in what you’ve said, you can see your words on the bottom of the screen in italics, but they never get posted. They simply disappear and the app freezes. You have to restart it to get it to work—repeatedly. Of course Anthropic will likely just launch a new model instead of addressing it.

15. And now they changed the buttery voice so Claude sounds like a slightly senile British uncle with dentures. (Yes. The mouth sounds they added to make the voice sound more life like actually sound like improper fitting dentures, anthropic… wtf?)

The Bottom Line: Before February, Claude was fabulous. It was an excellent assistant for writing, editing, data analysis, and conversation. It searched nearly as deeply as Perplexity. If I'd hired it as a tool, it would have earned it.

Now? I would fire it. It’s a constant battle to get Claude to work for me consistently. The sheer number of bugs is like a new negative adventure daily. Occasionally it works but never consistently, which is sad because as I said initially, this was in my opinion the best Ai “all around” on the market until February.

I can't justify paying for a broken product that degrades month after month while Anthropic prioritizes shiny new model releases over actually making the product work.
